goal: Prepare a safe source candidate and exact Singapore credential/operator packet for approved steps 1-2, preserving dirty work and all cloud release gates.
successCriteria: Inventory and materialize explicitly allowlisted source without browser profiles, secrets or build caches; stop on source drift.
Bind candidate bytes, target, migrations and validation results; distinguish clean isolated source from whole-app release acceptance.
Provide consumer-based credential matrix and activation prerequisites including currently unenforced cost controls.
Rehearse target lock, immutable input verification and no-overwrite receipts locally without cloud or credential execution.
untouchedSurfaces: All existing mobile/Admin/backend runtime behavior, route publication, credits, UI and content.
Root Git index/history and unrelated dirty work; credentials, platform settings, SQL and target allowlist activation.

impact.entryPoint: Owner-approved steps 1-2; offline source preparation CLI, local rehearsal and manager-readable packet.
impact.dataWrite: Only preparation tools, archive ignore boundaries, sanitized metadata and an isolated allowlisted source checkout under existing ignored cache.
impact.backendContract: Exact Singapore org/ref staging selection and existing release/target gates; no SQL, deploy, retarget, provider requests or new secrets.
impact.adminVisibility: Credential names/consumers/coverage and unresolved provenance/retention/route/cost controls; no secret values or Admin UI edits.
impact.privacySafety: Deny tracked browser/session profiles, environment/key files, symlinks and caches; do not clone all Git history or read secrets.
impact.observability: Stable sorted file/hash inventory, copy parity, local validation receipts and explicit blocked cloud/native/CI status.
impact.rollback: Remove only separately identified preparation output if requested; main working tree and prior evidence stay preserved. Fail on drift, collisions or unknown execution actions.

canonicalContracts: Existing release-profile targets remains empty and legacy migration ledger remains blocked; prepared inventory is not a snapshot bypass.
Rehearsal always releaseAuthorized=false and has no cloud execution or credential loading path.

skillReview.evidence: Read skill, expanded reference and release-control. Local preparation must preserve exact approval and remote enforcement boundaries; no change to skill policy.

dependencyReview.evidence: Use installed Node25.9.0, Git, PowerShell and locked dependencies; reviewed current Expo ignore precedence, Supabase secret boundary and GitHub environment limitations; no dependency installation.

externalSourceReview.reason: Verified EAS ignore precedence and requirement to include existing ignore boundaries before archive preparation.
Markdown endpoint unsupported; reviewed HTML changelog and relevant secret docs without cloud mutation.

Environment names and manual dispatch alone do not establish protected credential execution.

securityReview.authzRls: No runtime or access mutations. Managed Auth/RLS and service-only receipt acceptance remain blocking external checks.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Never read tracked browser profile contents or actual env/key files. Candidate explicit roots and denial paths prevent accidental bundling.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Only sanitized credential names/status. No values, session caches, new environment secrets or temporary download URLs.
securityReview.externalInput: Strict preparation packet actions, relative safe paths and target matching; no user command/script/SQL execution fields.
securityReview.dependencies: Use built-in filesystem/crypto and installed tooling. No new dependencies, arbitrary lifecycle commands or untrusted remote code.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Inventory current ordered SQL only; do not change blocked ledger or release allowlist. Fresh isolated commit does not certify deployment.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop candidate finalization on source drift, unsafe paths, secret suspicion, incomplete Tinh Quang validation, failed checks or missing current CI. Keep cloud execution disabled.

workingTreeReview.note: All preparation-owned source and generated evidence reviewed; earlier inventory/copy iterations retained as superseded. Final selector independently audited all known input types and rejects unknown types; old cached snapshots/profiles stay excluded. Main Git remains untouched.

validationCommands: Candidate input/hash/copy parity and nonsecret archive boundary checks
Current mobile/Admin/backend/governance/contract suites with sanitized logs and before-after source hashes
managerTestPath: Open preparation report, inspect candidate identity and required credentials, review PASS/BLOCKED evidence and proposed account-specific decisions; no password input or cloud action required.
residualRisk: Source filtering is not a full secret-history audit; local tests cannot establish remote CI, managed recovery, protected credentials or native acceptance. Existing runtime cost controls are not yet wired and paid activation stays blocked.
